title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
audience: College and university students from families with income below ₹8 lakh per annum
description: National scholarship for meritorious students from low-income families pursuing higher education. Covers both fresh and renewal applications.
eligibility: Scored above 80th percentile in Class XII board examinations
Annual family income below ₹8 lakh
Enrolled in a regular degree course (not distance/correspondence)
Not availing any other Central Government scholarship
benefits: ₹10,000 per annum for undergraduate students; ₹20,000 per annum for postgraduate students
needsVerification: Application window dates — verify on scholarships.gov.in
Exact renewal conditions

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste (SC) Students — Maharashtra
audience: SC students pursuing post-matriculation education in Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra government scholarship covering tuition fees and maintenance allowance for SC students studying after Class X.
eligibility: Belong to Scheduled Caste category recognized by Maharashtra government
Enrolled in post-matric course (Class XI onwards, including professional courses)
Annual family income below ₹2.5 lakh
Domicile of Maharashtra
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance as per Maharashtra government norms
needsVerification: Current income ceiling — verify on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in
Application window dates

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for Other Backward Class (OBC) Students — Maharashtra
audience: OBC students pursuing post-matriculation education in Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra state scholarship providing financial assistance to OBC students for post-matric courses including vocational, technical and professional programmes.
eligibility: Belong to OBC category recognized by Maharashtra government
Enrolled in post-matric course
Annual family income below ₹1 lakh
Domicile of Maharashtra
benefits: Tuition fee and maintenance allowance as per Maharashtra government norms
needsVerification: Current income ceiling for OBC — verify on official portal
Application dates

title: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti (EBC Scholarship)
audience: Economically Backward Class (EBC) students in Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra state scholarship named after Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj for students from economically backward classes not covered under SC/ST/OBC categories.
eligibility: Belong to Economically Backward Class (non-SC/ST/OBC)
Annual family income below ₹8 lakh
Enrolled in post-matric course in Maharashtra
Maharashtra domicile
benefits: Tuition fee and exam fee reimbursement as per Maharashtra norms
needsVerification: Current income ceiling — verify on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in

title: Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship for Minority Students
audience: Students from minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
description: Central government scholarship for students from minority communities studying in Class I to XII (Pre-Matric) and post-Class X courses (Post-Matric).
eligibility: Belong to a notified minority community
Annual family income below ₹1 lakh (Pre-Matric) or ₹2 lakh (Post-Matric)
Obtained at least 50% marks in previous exam
Not availing any other Central Government scholarship
benefits: Maintenance allowance + tuition fee component as per scheme norms
needsVerification: Current application window — verify on scholarships.gov.in

title: PM YASASVI Scholarship — OBC, EBC, and DNT Students
audience: Class IX, X, XI, XII students from OBC, EBC, and DNT communities
description: Prime Minister's Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for students from OBC, EBC, and De-notified Tribe communities selected through NTA entrance test.
eligibility: OBC, EBC, or DNT category student
Annual family income below ₹2.5 lakh
Studying in Class IX or XI in a school recognized by State/Central Government
Selected through PM YASASVI Entrance Test conducted by NTA
benefits: ₹75,000 per annum for Class IX-X; ₹1,25,000 per annum for Class XI-XII
needsVerification: NTA entrance test schedule — verify on yet.nta.ac.in

title: SWAYAM — Free Online Courses by NPTEL, IGNOU and Universities
audience: Students, working professionals, and lifelong learners across India
description: Government of India platform offering free online courses from IITs, IIMs, central universities, and IGNOU. Courses cover engineering, humanities, science, management, and more.
eligibility: Any Indian resident can enroll
No income or caste restriction
Some courses require Class X or XII qualification
Free enrollment; optional paid certificate exam
documents: Aadhaar card for certificate exam registration (if applicable)
benefits: Free course access; paid proctored certificate examination available for academic credit transfer
portal: SWAYAM — Study Webs of Active Learning for Young Aspiring Minds
needsVerification: Course-specific prerequisites — check swayam.gov.in for individual courses

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
audience: School dropouts, unemployed youth, and workers seeking upskilling
description: Flagship skill development scheme of the Government of India providing short-term training in industry-relevant skills with free certification and placement assistance.
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 15-45 years
School dropout or seeking upskilling
Aadhaar enrollment mandatory
Training conducted through empanelled Training Partners (TPs)
benefits: Free short-term skill training; NSQF-aligned certification; placement support; monetary reward on certification
needsVerification: Training centre availability near your district — check pmkvyofficial.org

title: Maharashtra State Skill Development Society (MSSDS) Training Programs
audience: Maharashtra youth seeking vocational skill training
description: Maharashtra government body offering skill training programs across various trades through government Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) and skill centres.
eligibility: Maharashtra domicile
Age and qualification vary by trade/course
Priority to SC/ST/OBC and economically weaker sections
benefits: Free or subsidized skill training; state-recognized certificate; placement assistance through MSSDS network
needsVerification: Current training batches and districts covered — verify on mssds.in

title: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)
description: Central scheme where the government pays the employer's EPF contribution for new employees earning up to ₹15,000/month to incentivize formal employment creation.
eligibility: New employees with salary up to ₹15,000 per month
Employee must have Aadhaar-linked UAN
Employer must be registered with EPFO
New employee must not have an existing EPF account
benefits: Government pays 12% employer EPF contribution for 3 years; promotes formal employment
portal: PMRPY — Ministry of Labour and Employment
needsVerification: Verify current scheme operational status on pmrpy.gov.in

title: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
audience: Maharashtra residents — families below poverty line and yellow ration card holders
description: Maharashtra state health insurance scheme providing cashless medical treatment for surgeries and critical illnesses at empanelled government and private hospitals.
eligibility: Maharashtra domicile
Hold a yellow (BPL), orange (below-APL), or white ration card
Farmers, journalists, and certain other categories as per latest government notification
Annual income below applicable limit (verify on portal)
benefits: Cashless treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals; critical illness coverage up to ₹2.5 lakh
needsVerification: Empanelled hospital list near your district — verify on jeevandayee.gov.in
Latest income and ration card eligibility categories

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
audience: Economically vulnerable families as per SECC data
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing cashless hospitalization cover to poor and vulnerable families at empanelled public and private hospitals across India.
eligibility: Listed in Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 database
No cap on family size
Covers pre-existing conditions from day one
No annual premium required from beneficiary
documents: Ration card or any family identity document
benefits: ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization at 27,000+ empanelled hospitals
needsVerification: Beneficiary eligibility check — use pmjay.gov.in/are-you-eligible

title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi — Direct Income Support for Farmers
audience: Small and marginal farmers with landholding up to 2 hectares
description: Central government scheme providing direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to eligible farmer families in three equal installments directly to their bank accounts.
eligibility: Land-holding farmer family (including Maharashtra farmers)
Landholding up to 2 hectares (as per original scheme; revised — verify)
Aadhaar-linked bank account mandatory
Not a current or former constitutional post holder, income taxpayer, or government employee (with exceptions)
documents: Land ownership records (7/12 extract in Maharashtra)
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three installments of ₹2,000 each, directly to bank account
needsVerification: Latest eligibility criteria — verify on pmkisan.gov.in

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana — Gramin (PMAY-G)
audience: Houseless and kutcha-house rural families identified in SECC 2011
description: Central scheme providing financial assistance to eligible rural families to construct pucca houses with basic amenities.
eligibility: Identified as houseless or living in kutcha/deteriorating house in SECC 2011 data
Rural area resident
Priority to SC/ST, freed bonded labour, minorities, and persons with disabilities
Not a beneficiary of any other central housing scheme
benefits: ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) per unit; also includes toilet assistance under SBM
needsVerification: Beneficiary waiting list status — check pmayg.nic.in or your Gram Panchayat

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana — Urban (PMAY-U)
audience: Urban poor, EWS and LIG families seeking affordable housing
description: Central scheme providing housing assistance to urban poor families under four verticals: In-situ Slum Redevelopment, Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS), Affordable Housing in Partnership, and Beneficiary-led Construction.
eligibility: EWS (annual income up to ₹3 lakh) or LIG (₹3-6 lakh) or MIG category
Urban area resident
No pucca house in family's name anywhere in India
First-time home buyer for CLSS component
benefits: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh under CLSS; construction grant under other verticals
needsVerification: Current scheme phase operational status — verify on pmaymis.gov.in

title: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) — Pension and Assistance Schemes
audience: Elderly, widows, and persons with disabilities from BPL households
description: Central programme comprising five sub-schemes providing social pensions and assistance: IGNOAPS (old age), IGNWPS (widows), IGNDPS (disability), NFBS (death of breadwinner), and Annapurna (food security).
eligibility: Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
Age 60+ for old age pension (IGNOAPS)
Widow aged 40-79 for widow pension (IGNWPS)
Person with 80%+ disability aged 18-79 for disability pension (IGNDPS)
documents: BPL ration card or SECC listing
Age proof (birth certificate / school leaving certificate)
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200-₹500 per month (Central share); states may top up — verify with Maharashtra Social Welfare Department
needsVerification: Maharashtra state top-up pension amounts — contact District Social Welfare Office

title: Startup Maharashtra — State Support for Entrepreneurs
audience: Entrepreneurs and startups based in or relocating to Maharashtra
description: Maharashtra government initiative providing recognition, mentorship, co-working spaces, funding facilitation, and regulatory support to startups through the Maharashtra State Innovation Society.
eligibility: Business entity incorporated in Maharashtra
Working on innovative product or scalable solution
Not more than 10 years since incorporation
Annual turnover below ₹100 crore (as per DPIIT startup definition guidelines)
documents: Bank account details of the entity
benefits: State startup recognition; access to Maharashtra Startup Week; co-working spaces; investor connect; regulatory fast-tracking; potential state grants
needsVerification: Current grant programs and timelines — verify on startup.maharashtra.gov.in

title: DigiLocker — Digital Document Wallet for Citizens
audience: All Indian citizens who need to store and share government documents digitally
description: Government of India platform that allows citizens to store, access, and share verified digital documents like Aadhaar, driving licence, marksheets, and certificates issued by government agencies.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen with Aadhaar and a mobile number
Free to use — no income or caste restriction
Available as web and mobile app
benefits: Free 1 GB secure cloud storage for government-issued documents; reduces need to carry physical documents; accepted as valid proof at many government offices
portal: DigiLocker — Ministry of Electronics and IT
needsVerification: List of issuing organizations and accepted documents — see digilocker.gov.in/issued-documents
